name: delinea
description: Delinea Secret Server and Platform tools for Claude, run locally via uvx

platform_hostname.title: Platform hostname (optional)
platform_hostname.description: <tenant>.secureplatform.io. Set when Secret Server runs on Delinea Platform; used for login and Platform tools.

platform_service_account.title: Platform service account (optional)
platform_service_account.description: Enables Platform user search and reports. Needs Platform hostname and service password.

platform_service_password.title: Platform service password (optional)
platform_service_password.description: Password for the Platform service account

platform_tenant_id.title: Platform tenant ID (optional)
platform_tenant_id.description: Only needed for multi-tenant Platform setups

enabled_tools.title: Enabled tools
enabled_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names. Leave blank for the read-only default set.
